notes.title: Shadow Pulse Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Great news, guys!

We are happy to announce that the Shadow Pulse demo is now available for download!
This is still an early build, but it will be the basis for many future improvements.

We have many updates coming - more content, tweaks and improvements to come, inspired by your feedback and our passion for the project.
If you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, do so to stay up to date with news, updates and the final release.

Thanks for staying with us!

notes.title: The Shadow Pulse Demo Is Knocking at the Door!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today marks the release of the very first demo version — an early alpha build, launching a bit ahead of schedule.
A mischievous gremlin-intern got our calendar months all mixed up... and our plans along with them!

Still, we didn’t want to leave you empty-handed — so we’ve put together a working build where you can already get a taste of the game’s core mechanics and atmosphere.

❗ Please note:
- Some features are still in development.
- Bugs and rough edges may occur.
- Optimization and content will be improved in future updates.

👷 We’re already hard at work on the next build and will be releasing a patch with improvements very soon.

Thank you for your interest and support — it keeps us going!

— The Shadow Pulse Team
